title: HTML Lists
summary: HTML lists group items together. An ordered list shows steps, and an unordered list shows items without a step order.
introduction: HTML lists group items together. An ordered list shows steps, and an unordered list shows items without a step order. Use numbers for a recipe and bullet points for a bag-packing list. Make both kinds, then put one list inside another.
learningObjectives: Create unordered, ordered and description lists
Control numbering with start, reversed and type

blocks.text: Use `<ul>` when the order of the items does not matter. Each item is an `<li>`; nothing else may be a direct child of `<ul>`.
Use `<ol>` when the sequence matters: instructions, rankings, steps. Browsers number the items automatically, so you do not type the numbers.

  2. Add the pasta.
  3. Cook for nine minutes.

blocks.text: To nest a list, place the inner `<ul>` or `<ol>` **inside** an `<li>` of the outer list, after the item's text.

Putting the inner `<ul>` *between* two `<li>` elements (as a direct child of the outer `<ul>`) is invalid, even though browsers often display it. The nested list belongs inside the item it relates to.
A description list `<dl>` pairs terms (`<dt>`) with descriptions (`<dd>`). It suits glossaries, metadata ("Author: …") and FAQs. A term may have several descriptions and vice versa.

blocks.code:
<dl>
  <dt>HTML</dt>
  <dd>The markup language that structures web pages.</dd>
  <dt>CSS</dt>
  <dd>The language that styles web pages.</dd>
  <dt>JavaScript</dt>
  <dd>The language that adds behaviour.</dd>
  <dd>Also used on servers through Node.js.</dd>
</dl>

blocks.text: A site menu is a list of links, so mark it up as one inside a `<nav>` element. Screen readers then announce how many items the menu has, and CSS can lay the items out horizontally.

blocks.title: Bullets are just a style
blocks.text: If you want a list without bullets, keep the `<ul>` and remove the markers with CSS (`list-style: none`). Replacing the list with a stack of `<div>` elements throws away the meaning.

seo.title: HTML Lists – ul, ol, dl, Nested Lists and Numbering
seo.description: Learn HTML unordered, ordered and description lists, how to nest lists correctly, control numbering with start, reversed and type, and build menus from lists.
